subject: ACK: RP10 dashboard wire + chart target label both fixed
body:
Both items resolved in commit a640243:

1. RP10 in dashboard (P2): index.html tests[] now includes retake-practice-10. Kai can reach it from dashboard. Manifest.json already had it (10 exams confirmed).

2. Chart target label (P3): 'Target: A (93%+)' -> 'Target: A (92%+)'. Matches grade 4 cutoff exactly. Same root cause as grade-a-flash fix.

Note on RP10 data quality: Wired per your spec, but holding firm on GR sign-off before using it for exam prep. Will not tell Kai to take RP10 until GR verifies.

Canvas keyboard nav also shipped (c7e0b0e): tabindex=0, Arrow keys + Enter, cursor ring, aria-live announcer. WCAG 2.1.1 complete.
